title: Jujubi ‒ Modern code forge built for speed
excerpt: Modern code forge built for speed.
content_html:
Code forge for power users

Local-first. Precise reviews. Safe merges. Drop-in replacement.

Nothing in your way

No clutter, no spinners, no outages. Stay in the flow.

Instant, always

A sync engine keeps your work local. No page loads, no waiting.

Works offline

Bad signal, no internet, or outage? You keep working regardless.

Keyboard first

Every action has a shortcut or a command. No menu diving.

No blind spots

See exactly what changed. Never miss what matters.

Interdiffs

See what changed between any two PR versions, nothing more.

Hunk checkpoints

Mark hunks as viewed, not just files. Know exactly what’s left.

Diff ignores

Auto-mark noise as viewed. Only review what demands it.

Semantic diffs

Review actual changes, not lines. Fewer misreads, faster decisions.

Ship with confidence

Nothing slips through. Nothing blocks you.

Merge queues

Every merge is queued. No broken main, no babysitting merges.

Stacked PRs

Split big PRs into smaller ones. No waiting, no conflicts.

Soft approvals

Approve without owning the merge. More eyes on every change.

Advanced rules

Enforce exactly what matters. No workarounds needed.

Bring everything with you

No rewrites, no migrations. Your workflows come with you.

Compatible API

Change the URL, not the code. Keep every integration and script.

Same CI

Keep your CI config. Your pipelines stay intact.

Jujutsu ready

Designed to grow with it. Not as an afterthought.

Evolog

Browse every version of a change. Know how it evolved.

Branchless

Open a PR from any change. No branch, no ceremony.
